facts.fact: 绿裙污渍来源揭示：血洗得掉、黏土洗不掉——Veronica 把绿裙扔进火里烧掉
facts.anchor: “I can get the blood out, girl, but that clay has set

facts.fact: Rue 冷静下单重做绿裙，还提要求：领口更高、多珠饰
facts.anchor: Another one of green silk, though I would like the neckline higher

facts.fact: Veronica 嫉妒发问：「她抱你了吗」「你在地下和她在一起时」——她渴望被母亲要求留下
facts.anchor: When you were down there, beneath the earth with her?

facts.fact: Rue 内白：Veronica 眼中的天使实为怪物——死亡不碰也不留她；夜里不朽、黎明衰朽、睡进土里重生
facts.anchor: She sees my mother as an angel

facts.fact: Rue 断言无论献肉、自鞭、尽职，Veronica 终有缓慢而最终的一死；她盼的永恒不会来，或许她的鬼也会留在 Folkehaven
Rue 咬开内里发黑的烂苹果，补一句「But she did not ask you」——扎心收尾
facts.anchor: It is blackened inside but still sweet

facts.fact: Veronica 揭底：Anne Pengelly 的未婚夫被 Rue 母亲吃掉，Anne 的「Thank you」耳语别有深意
facts.anchor: Your mother ate the man she was to marry

facts.fact: Rue 盯着 Anne 的欢乐：想撕一块下来尝尝，看那是不是属于自己的东西
facts.anchor: I want to tear it from her
